name: percolate
description: Save, read and revise research packages in Percolate: arguments a reader can check, with the evidence behind each claim.

interface.shortDescription: Research packages with evidence a reader can check
interface.longDescription: Turn an argument into a research package that states its question, its claims and the sources behind each one. Import an essay from a link without copying its text, find work that answers the same question differently, and see what supports a package before you trust it. Everything you save stays private to you until you publish it.
defaultPrompt: Import this essay into Percolate as a private draft: <link>
Does anyone disagree with the main claim in my latest Percolate package?
What supports my Percolate package on this topic, and where is it weakest?
